title_en: Rain in the middle of the drive
jp_sentences: 土曜の朝、友と山へドライブに出かけました。
山の道を走っていたら、とつぜん雨がふりました。
とにかく近くの店に入って、ともにコーヒーを飲みました。
店ではとしよりの人たちがトランプをしていました。
雨が止んだら、また出発しました。
夜は家で友とドラマを見て、楽しい一日が終わりました。
jp: 土曜の朝、友と山へドライブに出かけました。山の道を走っていたら、とつぜん雨がふりました。とにかく近くの店に入って、ともにコーヒーを飲みました。店ではとしよりの人たちがトランプをしていました。雨が止んだら、また出発しました。夜は家で友とドラマを見て、楽しい一日が終わりました。
translation_pt: Sábado de manhã, saí para dar uma volta de carro na serra com um amigo. Estávamos na estrada da montanha quando, de repente, começou a chover. De qualquer forma, entramos numa lanchonete ali perto e tomamos café juntos. Na lanchonete tinha um grupo de idosos jogando baralho. Quando a chuva parou, seguimos viagem. À noite assisti a uma série em casa com meu amigo, e foi o fim de um dia bem divertido.
translation_en: On Saturday morning I went out for a drive to the mountains with a friend. We were on the mountain road when it suddenly started to rain. Anyway, we ducked into a shop nearby and had coffee together. In the shop a group of older people were playing cards. When the rain stopped, we set off again. At night I watched a drama at home with my friend, and a fun day came to an end.
authoring_note: The gating lesson introduces no new grammar (it is a vocabulary lesson for the と-row words), so the passage targets gram:tara from the cumulative known set, used twice, and carries the lesson's new vocabulary. 突然 and 年寄り are written in kana because 突 and 寄 are not in the lesson's kanji known set; お茶 was avoided because Sudachi always splits it into お + 茶 and 茶 alone is not unlocked.
